task_description:
Acting as therapist Benjamin Ortiz, update patient Leona Maddox’s therapy records as follows:

1) Create and populate a new session:
- Create a new therapy session for Leona Maddox on 2025-10-15 with duration 40 minutes and notes: “Post-evaluation session focused on shoulder mobility.”
- Add these exercises to that session:
  - Wall Slides: 30 repetitions, 2 sets, intensity 3.
    - Append progress note: “Good scapular control; mild tightness at end range.”
  - Arm Circles: 20 repetitions, 3 sets, intensity 2.
    - Append progress note: “No pain; fatigue noted in final set.”
- After adding Arm Circles, update only its intensity to 3 (keep reps/sets unchanged) and append a new progress note: “Increased intensity tolerated without pain.”

2) Modify Leona’s session on 2024-05-21:
- Update the session duration to 35 minutes and set notes to: “Extended session to accommodate additional ankle pump sets.”
- For Ankle Pumps in this session, update repetitions to 22 and intensity to 3.
- Append a progress note to Ankle Pumps: “Improved circulation; slight swelling reduced.”

3) Replace an exercise in Leona’s session on 2023-12-09:
- Add Arm Circles with 15 repetitions, 2 sets, intensity 2 to this session.
- Append a progress note to Arm Circles: “Introduced mobility warm-up before flexibility work.”
- Delete Wall Slides from this 2023-12-09 session so that Arm Circles remains as the session’s exercise.
